shortDescription: Shared home route view renderer for the dashboard home feed and user profile overview screens.
fullDescription: Presents the root view through a typed view-and-state renderer that keeps both the dashboard-home-feed and user-profile-overview default states available from one implementation. The route composes a reusable chrome header, repository cards, contribution heatmap, and dashboard feed cards while preserving interactive local state for search, tab selection, feed selection, and contribution year changes.
